reviews.text: I enjoyed the game very much. The idea of dice rolling on your desktop while farming loot is simple but very addictive. The loot system, upgrades, skills, and rare drops make it exciting to keep checking progress. It also feels great as a desktop companion game because it does not need constant attention, but still gives you plenty of reasons to come back. I knew from the demo that this game was going to be a hit. One of the best idle games in recent times. Highly recommended!

很质朴的挂机游戏，但是前期体验不是很好，主要是因为他把一些其他游戏里的便捷功能做成了升级项目，比如自动升级，自动售出等等，以及前期的物品爆率低得可怜，挂上两三个小时也基本刷不到什么东西。但是等你把各种升级点出来后，他就越来越接近一个正常的挂机游戏，可以放在那不管，一觉睡醒就发现又多往前推了几关。现在我的进度应该也只能算中期吧，后期挂起来应该更舒服，更自动化。总的来说，我感觉他的质量还是符合他这个价格的. 以上是第一天的感受 —————————————————————————— 通关后的感受，还是不推荐 1、前期要一直手动，隔一会就要上来点几下，隔一会就要上来点几下，可以说大部分的时间是花在这一阶段，这里可能花费了我半天吧。过了这一阶段，进入半自动，就可以隔几小时点几下，就这样过了一天左右，这个阶段就过去了，就进入了全自动阶段，就可以完全不管了。问题就出在后面，其他游戏进入全自动放置阶段后，后面内容还有一堆，玩家还能有些许追求，但是这游戏进入全自动阶段到我通关，就三小时，你知道我早上一看可以全自动了，高高兴兴去上班，结果中午休息回来一看，通关了的感觉是什么吗？很失望，后面没内容了，甚至连最简单的数值堆砌都没有了，失望透顶了。 2、关卡等级1000就到上限了，玩家后期数值膨胀得很离谱，我用着600级的骰子就已经全都是秒杀，直接让我丧失了对装备更新换代的想法。 3、背包小到离谱，这是一点，但是这个不是关键，关键是直到后期，那些自动升级、自动卖出的东西，他的生效频率自始至终就没变过。前中期你10分钟升级一下、卖一次，我理解，毕竟前中期东西少，资源少，后期我一秒满背包了，你还是十分钟卖一次？我要刷一个毕业骰子还得疯狂手动卖骰子，不然背包一直被垃圾骰子占着，新骰子根本刷不到，你觉得合理吗？ 4、不能直观了解我的输出水平。如上面所说，关卡1000级就上限了，而且好像是从四五百级开始就是一路秒杀了，我都不知道我自己输出究竟多高，换套搭配之后输出是升还是降。 5、地图，地图刷完后给了一堆东西，但是居然要先放进背包才能制作下一张地图，而且也不能直接在结算界面卖掉，然后你背包永远是满的，这就导致大后期才出来的这个地图的内容就是个摆设，刷完了永远拿不到奖励，就只能重置然后才能重新刷。然后这个地图给的永久属性在重置的时候会不会一起被重置掉也没有说。 总之，问题很多。虽然价格便宜，但是还是不推荐。我看他家之前也出了几个同类的游戏了吧，虽然我没玩，但是看评价也是不太OK，内容很少，就感觉他家出这类游戏就是想割韭菜来的，大家请避雷。

31 hours and achieved 100%, here's my verdict. Pros: 1. The it's literally incremental, it's increasing in difficulty as you progress through the game, but it's not that steep that makes you frustated. 2. All builds work, while i strongly support build in game, this takes me to another level of standard. Literally all build works (knight, arrow, beam, etc.) and to min/max-ing all the dices, gemstones, rings, and automation, it's achievable, and that what makes me going to play longer for hours just to max one build. 3. You thought this is an idle game, at the beginning you'll probably want this or that feature, but that especially what makes it great. It comes sooner than you think, and even more important, IT'S THERE! Cons: 1. Some feature are not explained enough (eg: each dice feature, how the damage calculation works, basic information such as beam duration, beam speed, shadow damage, and others are not there). You need to think how it work, and will it work. 2. Bug, literally. There's a feature to lower the effect amount, but it "slows" you down from killing those mobs. Somehow the damage is not updated in real time. IF, you bump up that effect amount, it will just kill your pc (trust me, i've tried with 4 shadows) All over all, i'll rate this game 9/10. One of the top idle game on my library, and probably the only one so far that i'll keep playing past 100% achievement. The only minus is the cons, but i believe it would be easily solveable (for the number 1) EDIT: the game keep crashing during my attempt to 110% now i cannot get that 25k max rolls

A surprisingly deep idle game Desktop Nard is a genuinely fun idle game that does a few things really well. The skill trees feel non-linear, which is a nice change of pace from the usual "follow the one path" progression you get in a lot of incremental games. The varied trees keep things fresh, and figuring out the best items and combinations is where the game really starts to shine. The pacing feels spot on, and even though it's an idle game, there was almost always something to actually do if I felt like engaging. It never just becomes a "leave it running and forget about it" situation, which I appreciated. I clocked around 35 hours of idle play to get through the achievements, which is already fantastic value for money. But what really says it all is that I finished the achievements and still didn't want to stop. I'm still playing because I want to collect everything, and that kind of staying power is pretty rare. Absolutely got my money's worth here. If you're into idle or incremental games, this one's worth it.

While it could benefit from some more content and QoL additions, the basic gameplay loop is fun. I would really like to see a true loot filter which is adjustable for each loot tab. Overall I've found this game addicting, enjoyable, and rewarding. Edit: Unfortunately I have run into a game breaking bug and cannot recommend the game until it's fixed. I tried the mobile version and seem to have run into the same bug. It is quite disappointing, but I guess I was pretty much at endgame anyway (level 1500+). After further testing, the bug seems to cause a crash at some point when an inventory is full and another item is earned. I feel that a more granular loot filter is needed to 1) make endgame progression rewarding and 2) avoid having situations where I need to mass delete drops to avoid a crash. At this point, I'd be interested in keeping just ancient+ rings, high tier stats on gems, and golden dice of a certain level and with faces 3. Unfortunately I can only select the loot rarity to delete and hope that I don't miss something important before I have to mass delete to avoid a crash.

Honestly, the game isn't bad. It's a fun enough experience that you can easily 100% in less than 35 hours. Art and animations are good, if a little bright (I ran a full Beam Dice build and it was near blinding) and it doesn't have too many frame drops. The only negatives really are some lacking QoL features like: * Closing windows/menus when clicking off of them or hitting escape - Clicking off does nothing and hitting escape brings up the game menu on top of what you wanted to close. * Occasional graphical glitches where the dice were too large. * Tooltips could be a little better with clearer descriptions. But I'd still recommend the game as 30-35 hours for a few bucks is definitely worth it.
